assignment.title: Python Fundamentals - Week 1
assignment.description: Practice basic Python programming concepts including variables, data types, arithmetic operations, and simple string manipulation.

questions.title: Variable Declaration
questions.description: Create a variable named 'age' and assign it the value 25

questions.title: Simple Arithmetic
questions.description: Calculate the product of 8 and 9, and store it in a variable named 'product'

questions.title: String Variable
questions.description: Create a variable 'greeting' containing the string 'Hello, World!'

questions.title: List Creation
questions.description: Create a list named 'numbers' containing the integers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

questions.title: Sum Calculation
questions.description: Calculate the sum of 15, 30, and 45, store it in a variable named 'total'

questions.title: String Length
questions.description: Create a string 'message' with value 'Python' and store its length in a variable 'msg_length'

test_cases.test_code:
passed = 'age' in locals() and age == 25
feedback = 'Perfect! age = 25' if passed else 'Create variable age with value 25'

passed = 'product' in locals() and product == 72
feedback = 'Excellent! 8 * 9 = 72' if passed else f'Expected 72, got {product if "product" in locals() else "nothing"}'

passed = 'greeting' in locals() and greeting == 'Hello, World!'
feedback = 'Great job!' if passed else f'Expected "Hello, World!", got {greeting if "greeting" in locals() else "nothing"}'

passed = 'numbers' in locals() and numbers == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
feedback = 'Perfect list!' if passed else f'Expected [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], got {numbers if "numbers" in locals() else "nothing"}'

passed = 'total' in locals() and total == 90
feedback = 'Correct! 15 + 30 + 45 = 90' if passed else f'Expected 90, got {total if "total" in locals() else "nothing"}'

passed = 'message' in locals() and message == 'Python' and 'msg_length' in locals() and msg_length == 6
feedback = 'Excellent!' if passed else 'Check message="Python" and msg_length=len(message)'
